# Eight minutes of altitude-bearing Mode S frames for six aircraft, taken
# from a live BEAST feed: DF17 airborne positions, DF4 surveillance replies
# and DF20 Comm-B replies. One frame per line, as milliseconds since the
# first frame and the frame in hex. The DF17 frames have their CPR latitude
# and longitude zeroed and their parity recomputed, so the fixture keeps the
# addresses and altitudes and nothing about where they were heard. Most of
# the DF4 and DF20 frames are noise whose parity happens to recover one of
# these addresses, with a random altitude field. See phantom_internal_test.go.
